records.name: Arcana
records.summary: Arcana offers wielders a volatile power, but it is incredibly potent when correctly channeled.

records.name: Blade
records.summary: Wielders of Blade dedicate themselves to achieving inexorable power over death.

records.name: Bone
records.summary: Adherents to Bone gain an unparalleled understanding of bodies and their movements.

records.name: Codex
records.summary: Codex offers a commanding and versatile understanding of magic to devotees who pursue knowledge beyond the boundaries of common wisdom.

records.name: Grace
records.summary: Grace offers its wielders raw magnetism and mastery over language.

records.name: Midnight
records.summary: Midnight offers practitioners the power to control and create enigmas.

records.name: Sage
records.summary: Sage grants its adherents the vitality of a blooming flower and the ferocity of a ravenous predator.

records.name: Splendor
records.summary: Splendor is the domain of life. Through this magic, followers gain the ability to heal and, to an extent, control death.

records.name: Valor
records.summary: Valor offers great power to those who raise their shields in defense of others.
